capabilities.name: Read place value in whole numbers
capabilities.description: Read and write multi-digit whole numbers and identify the value of each digit.

capabilities.name: Add and subtract multi-digit numbers
capabilities.description: Use written addition and subtraction accurately, including carrying and borrowing.

capabilities.name: Multiply multi-digit numbers
capabilities.description: Use written multiplication to calculate products involving multi-digit numbers.

capabilities.name: Divide whole numbers
capabilities.description: Use written division and interpret a quotient and any remainder in context.

capabilities.name: Choose the order of operations
capabilities.description: Evaluate expressions containing several operations and parentheses in the correct order.

capabilities.name: Use inverse operations
capabilities.description: Find an unknown number or check a calculation using the inverse relationship between operations.

capabilities.name: Use addition and subtraction properties
capabilities.description: Reorder and group additions or rewrite subtractions to make a calculation easier.

capabilities.name: Apply the distributive property
capabilities.description: Factor or expand products to simplify calculations with a common factor.

capabilities.name: Recognize a useful nearby number
capabilities.description: Rewrite a number using a nearby round number to simplify a sum or product.

capabilities.name: Simplify products and quotients by cancellation
capabilities.description: Rearrange a chain of multiplication and division so matching factors cancel correctly.

capabilities.name: Divide by a product or quotient
capabilities.description: Rewrite division by a parenthesized product or quotient without changing its value.

capabilities.name: Check arithmetic with estimation
capabilities.description: Estimate a result and use inverse operations to detect unreasonable answers.

capabilities.name: Interpret decimal place value
capabilities.name_zh: 认识小数数位和计数单位
capabilities.description: Identify decimal place values and distinguish a decimal’s value from its counting unit.

capabilities.name: Compare equivalent decimal forms
capabilities.description: Recognize that trailing zeros can leave a decimal’s value unchanged while changing its written place unit.

capabilities.name: Add and subtract decimals
capabilities.description: Align decimal places and calculate decimal sums and differences accurately.

capabilities.name: Simplify decimal expressions
capabilities.description: Group positive and negative decimal terms to form convenient whole-number totals.

capabilities.name: Interpret a fraction and its unit
capabilities.description: Explain the numerator, denominator, and unit fraction using equal parts of a whole.

capabilities.name: Add and subtract like-denominator fractions
capabilities.description: Combine or subtract fractions with the same denominator.

capabilities.name: Simplify grouped fraction calculations
capabilities.description: Remove parentheses correctly and group compatible fractional terms.

capabilities.name: Solve a one-step equation
capabilities.description: Find an unknown in an equation by applying the same inverse operation to both sides.

capabilities.name: Solve an equation with parentheses
capabilities.description: Expand parentheses, collect like terms, and check the resulting solution.

capabilities.name: Choose efficient calculation methods
capabilities.description: Recognize when written calculation, an operation property, cancellation, or an equation is most useful and verify the result.

capabilities.name: Translate a word problem into operations
capabilities.name_zh: 把文字条件转化为算式
capabilities.description: Identify the known quantities, the unknown, and the operations linking them.

capabilities.name: Keep track of units
capabilities.description: Attach appropriate units to quantities and check that an answer has the required unit.

capabilities.name: Solve successive total-and-remainder problems
capabilities.name_zh: 解决总量与剩余量问题
capabilities.description: Track a starting amount through purchases, uses, or other changes to find a total or remainder.

capabilities.name: Find a quantity from a simple multiple
capabilities.description: Use a multiplicative comparison to find one quantity from another.

capabilities.name: Solve sum-and-difference problems
capabilities.description: Find two quantities when their sum and difference are known.

capabilities.name: Solve difference-and-multiple problems
capabilities.description: Use a bar model or equal parts to find two quantities from their difference and ratio.

capabilities.name: Handle an offset in a multiple relationship
capabilities.name_zh: 带多几少几的倍数问题
capabilities.description: Adjust for an amount more or less than an exact multiple before finding the unit part.

capabilities.name: Track transfers between two people
capabilities.description: Account for how giving an amount changes both quantities and their difference.

capabilities.name: Work backward through operations
capabilities.description: Reverse a sequence of arithmetic changes from its final value.

capabilities.name: Work backward through transfers
capabilities.description: Restore the earlier holdings of several people by reversing transfers in order.

capabilities.name: Recognize a two-case assumption problem
capabilities.description: Recognize when a total count and a second total arise from two types with different contributions.

capabilities.name: Solve a basic two-case assumption problem
capabilities.description: Assume all items are one type and use the discrepancy to find the number of each type.

capabilities.name: Solve a disguised two-case assumption problem
capabilities.description: Remove fixed contributions and identify the two variable contributions before applying the assumption method.

capabilities.name: Compare two distribution plans
capabilities.description: Use the change in amount per person and the change in surplus or shortage to find the number of people.

capabilities.name: Find a constant rate
capabilities.description: Divide a total by the relevant numbers of workers, items, or time units to obtain a unit rate.

capabilities.name: Solve multi-factor rate problems
capabilities.description: Use a constant unit rate to relate different numbers of workers, time periods, and output amounts.

capabilities.name: Relate distance, speed, and time
capabilities.description: Choose and use distance equals speed times time, including its inverse forms.

capabilities.name: Calculate average speed over stages
capabilities.description: Find total distance and total time before calculating average speed.

capabilities.name: Compare early and late arrivals
capabilities.name_zh: 提前与迟到的行程问题
capabilities.description: Represent two travel speeds relative to a common deadline and determine the journey length.

capabilities.name: Find an arithmetic mean
capabilities.description: Divide a total by the number of values and interpret the result in context.

capabilities.name: Use changes in an average
capabilities.name_zh: 利用平均数变化求数量
capabilities.description: Relate a change in one score or amount to the resulting change in the overall average.

capabilities.name: Recognize what stays fixed in an age problem
capabilities.description: Use the fact that people age by the same amount while their age difference stays fixed.

capabilities.name: Solve present-age sum and difference problems
capabilities.description: Convert ages given at another time to present conditions and find each age.

capabilities.name: Solve ages at different times
capabilities.name_zh: 过去与未来年龄倍数问题
capabilities.description: Use a timeline or bar model to connect age ratios at different times.

capabilities.name: Solve multi-person age relationships
capabilities.description: Track several people’s ages across different dates while preserving pairwise age differences.

capabilities.name: Model scored right-and-wrong questions
capabilities.description: Use the score change between a correct and an incorrect response to find how many of each occurred.

capabilities.name: Track repeated transformations
capabilities.description: Represent how each of two kinds of action changes a quantity and determine their counts from a final state.

capabilities.name: Choose a model for a word problem
capabilities.name_zh: 辨认并选择应用题模型
capabilities.description: Distinguish additive, multiplicative, rate, average, age, transfer, assumption, and surplus-shortage structures.

capabilities.name: Solve and check multi-step word problems
capabilities.description: Select a suitable model, carry out the steps, and check the answer against every condition.

capabilities.name: Find perimeter by counting boundary lengths
capabilities.description: Add the lengths on a figure’s outer boundary without counting internal edges.

capabilities.name: Find rectangle and square perimeters
capabilities.description: Calculate a perimeter or recover a missing side using the rectangle or square formula.

capabilities.name: Find rectangle and square areas
capabilities.description: Calculate an area or recover a missing side using the rectangle or square formula.

capabilities.name: Distinguish perimeter from area
capabilities.description: Choose boundary length or covered surface as appropriate and use the corresponding units.

capabilities.name: Combine equal small shapes
capabilities.name_zh: 由相同小图形求大图形
capabilities.description: Infer the dimensions of a composite shape from its arrangement of equal small shapes.

capabilities.name: Find an irregular rectilinear perimeter
capabilities.description: Match horizontal and vertical segments to find missing lengths and the whole perimeter.

capabilities.name: Track perimeter changes after moving parts
capabilities.name_zh: 平移拼块后的周长变化
capabilities.description: Identify newly exposed boundary segments after parts of a figure are moved.

capabilities.name: Find a composite area by partitioning
capabilities.name_zh: 分割法求组合图形面积
capabilities.description: Split a figure into known shapes and add their areas.

capabilities.name: Find a composite area by subtraction
capabilities.name_zh: 补形法求组合图形面积
capabilities.description: Enclose a figure in a simpler shape and subtract unwanted areas.

capabilities.name: Identify a base and its height
capabilities.description: Identify the perpendicular height corresponding to a chosen base, including one drawn outside a shape.

capabilities.name: Find a parallelogram’s area
capabilities.description: Use the corresponding base and height to find a parallelogram’s area or a missing dimension.

capabilities.name: Find a triangle’s area
capabilities.description: Use a triangle’s base and corresponding height, accounting for the factor of one half.

capabilities.name: Find a trapezoid’s area
capabilities.description: Use both parallel sides and the perpendicular height to calculate a trapezoid’s area.

capabilities.name: Scale square dimensions and area
capabilities.name_zh: 正方形边长与面积的倍数
capabilities.description: Relate a change in square perimeter or side length to the resulting change in area.

capabilities.name: Measure an angle
capabilities.description: Align a protractor correctly, read the appropriate scale, and report an angle in degrees.

capabilities.name: Choose and apply a geometry method
capabilities.description: Identify the relevant dimensions and choose perimeter, area, partition, subtraction, or scaling methods for a figure.

capabilities.name: Find a term in a constant-difference sequence
capabilities.description: Use the first term, common difference, and position to find a specified term.

capabilities.name: Find the number of terms in a constant-difference sequence
capabilities.description: Count terms from the first and last values, including both endpoints.

capabilities.name: Sum a constant-difference sequence
capabilities.description: Pair first and last terms or use the average term to calculate the sequence sum.

capabilities.name: Recognize a repeating cycle
capabilities.description: Find the length and order of a repeating block.

capabilities.name: Locate an item in a repeating cycle
capabilities.description: Divide a position by the cycle length and interpret the remainder, including a zero remainder.

capabilities.name: Read a regular number array
capabilities.description: Relate a number’s row and column to its position in a regularly filled array.

capabilities.name: Count digits used in numbering
capabilities.description: Separate one-, two-, and three-digit labels to find a total digit count or the final page.

capabilities.name: Interpret a newly defined operation
capabilities.description: Infer a stated operation’s rule from examples and apply it to new inputs.

capabilities.name: Recognize and extend numerical patterns
capabilities.name_zh: 综合识别与运用数的规律
capabilities.description: Distinguish increasing, repeating, array, and defined-operation rules and use the appropriate one.

capabilities.name: Count with a systematic list
capabilities.description: List possibilities in a fixed order so none are missed or repeated.

capabilities.name: Use the addition rule of counting
capabilities.description: Split possibilities into nonoverlapping cases and add their counts.

capabilities.name: Use the multiplication rule of counting
capabilities.description: Count independent successive choices by multiplying the number of choices at each step.

capabilities.name: Count arrangements of distinct objects
capabilities.description: Count ways to place distinct objects in distinct positions without reuse.

capabilities.name: Handle a forbidden leading zero
capabilities.description: Count multi-digit numbers made from given digits while excluding those that begin with zero.

capabilities.name: Count digit arrangements with restrictions
capabilities.name_zh: 按奇偶或倍数条件组数
capabilities.description: Apply place-value, parity, or divisibility restrictions before counting arrangements.

capabilities.name: Use a divisibility test for four
capabilities.description: Determine whether a whole number is divisible by four from its last two digits.

capabilities.name: Count choices by subsets
capabilities.description: Count combinations of available distinct objects and account for whether choosing none is allowed.

capabilities.name: Distinguish ordered from unordered distributions
capabilities.description: Decide whether swapping recipients or rearranging piles creates a new outcome.

capabilities.name: Count positive distributions to named recipients
capabilities.name_zh: 至少分一个的有序分配
capabilities.description: Systematically count ways to distribute identical objects among named recipients with a minimum for each.

capabilities.name: Count unequal unordered piles
capabilities.description: List distinct positive pile sizes in increasing order so equivalent rearrangements count once.

capabilities.name: Distribute first and then arrange
capabilities.description: Find allowable pile sizes and then count assignments of those sizes to named recipients.

capabilities.name: Count possibilities with a tree diagram
capabilities.description: Build a branching diagram for sequential choices subject to restrictions.

capabilities.name: Count simple shortest grid paths
capabilities.name_zh: 简单网格最短路线计数
capabilities.description: Identify required moves and count short routes on a small grid without unnecessary detours.

capabilities.name: Count constrained or surface paths
capabilities.name_zh: 受限制与立体表面路线计数
capabilities.description: Split a path diagram into cases or use intermediate-point counts when a single grid rule is insufficient.

capabilities.name: Count segments in repeated arrangements
capabilities.description: Distinguish the number of gaps or cuts from the number of objects or pieces they create.

capabilities.name: Count objects along a line
capabilities.description: Count equally spaced positions while accounting for whether each endpoint is included.

capabilities.name: Count the boundary of a square array
capabilities.description: Count a square array’s outer layer without counting its corner positions twice.

capabilities.name: Relate filled and hollow square arrays
capabilities.description: Use side lengths or successive layer counts to find totals and missing dimensions.

capabilities.name: Count pairs and maximum intersections
capabilities.description: Count distinct pairs of points or lines and state the conditions needed to attain the maximum.

capabilities.name: Count nested figures by size
capabilities.description: Count triangles or other figures systematically by size or position without duplication.

capabilities.name: Choose and verify a counting method
capabilities.name_zh: 综合选择并检验计数方法
capabilities.description: Recognize whether a task needs listing, cases, stages, arrangements, distributions, or path counting and check for omissions and duplicates.

capabilities.name: Represent groups with overlapping circles
capabilities.description: Place totals, overlaps, and neither-group counts in the correct regions of a two-group diagram.

capabilities.name: Count a union of two groups
capabilities.description: Subtract a shared part counted twice when finding how many belong to at least one group.

capabilities.name: Find only-one and neither counts
capabilities.name_zh: 求只属于一类与两类都不属于
capabilities.description: Use a total and overlapping group counts to find exclusive and outside regions.

capabilities.name: Interpret three-group conditions
capabilities.description: Distinguish only-one, exactly-two, and all-three regions when organizing information about three groups.

capabilities.name: Apply the pigeonhole principle
capabilities.description: Find how many objects or containers guarantee that one container reaches a specified count.

capabilities.name: Count multiples using overlap
capabilities.description: Count numbers divisible by either of two divisors without double-counting common multiples.

capabilities.name: Determine expression parity
capabilities.name_zh: 判断算式结果的奇偶性
capabilities.description: Track oddness and evenness through sums, differences, and products without evaluating large numbers.

capabilities.name: Use set and number properties in combination
capabilities.name_zh: 综合运用集合与数的性质
capabilities.description: Choose overlap counting, divisibility, parity, or pigeonhole reasoning and justify the choice.

capabilities.name: Use row, column, and diagonal sum constraints
capabilities.description: Write equal-sum relationships for rows, columns, or diagonals to find missing entries.

capabilities.name: Solve a three-by-three magic square
capabilities.description: Use shared entries and equal line sums to deduce missing numbers in a small magic square.

capabilities.name: Solve a larger magic array
capabilities.description: Combine several row, column, and diagonal equations to solve a larger array.

capabilities.name: Use equal-product grid constraints
capabilities.description: Compare row, column, and diagonal products to determine unknown nonzero entries.

capabilities.name: Solve a digit puzzle by column
capabilities.description: Track carries and digit restrictions from one column to the next in an unknown-digit calculation.

capabilities.name: Organize clues in a logic table
capabilities.description: Record possible and impossible assignments and use clues to eliminate cases.

capabilities.name: Deduce a grid from row and column clues
capabilities.description: Combine row, column, adjacency, and exclusion clues to fill a constrained grid.

capabilities.name: Check a deduction for uniqueness
capabilities.name_zh: 检验推理结果的唯一性
capabilities.description: Test a proposed solution against every clue and determine whether another solution remains possible.

capabilities.name: Solve mixed logic and number puzzles
capabilities.description: Choose equations, place-value reasoning, tables, or grid exclusions and verify all constraints.

capabilities.name: Identify odd-degree vertices
capabilities.description: Count edges meeting at each vertex of a network and identify vertices of odd degree.

capabilities.name: Test whether a figure can be drawn in one stroke
capabilities.description: Use connectedness and the number of odd-degree vertices to decide whether a one-stroke drawing is possible.

capabilities.name: Modify a network for one-stroke drawing
capabilities.description: Predict how adding or removing an edge changes vertex parity and one-stroke feasibility.

capabilities.name: Represent tournament results
capabilities.name_zh: 用表或图记录比赛结果
capabilities.description: Record each pair’s match and infer possible wins, draws, losses, and scores.

capabilities.name: Schedule short jobs first
capabilities.description: Order jobs on one server to minimize the combined waiting and service time.

capabilities.name: Schedule jobs across parallel servers
capabilities.description: Assign and order jobs across several servers to reduce total completion time.

capabilities.name: Minimize movement to one location
capabilities.name_zh: 集中运输的最省费用地点
capabilities.description: Compare weighted travel distances to choose a low-cost gathering location.

capabilities.name: Minimize costs in a small transport table
capabilities.name_zh: 调运方案的费用最优化
capabilities.description: Meet supply and demand constraints while comparing the cost of alternative assignments.

capabilities.name: Justify a best arrangement
capabilities.name_zh: 说明最优方案为什么最优
capabilities.description: Compare alternatives or explain why an exchange cannot improve a proposed schedule or transport plan.

capabilities.name: Solve small optimization and network problems
capabilities.name_zh: 综合解决网络与最优化问题
capabilities.description: Represent the constraints, choose an appropriate network or cost strategy, and check the proposed result.

capabilities.name: Recognize the structure of an unfamiliar problem
capabilities.name_zh: 辨认陌生题目的数学结构
capabilities.description: Separate the story and diagram from their underlying quantities, relationships, restrictions, and goal.

capabilities.name: Select, combine, and validate course methods
capabilities.description: Independently choose and combine course methods for an unfamiliar problem, then verify that the answer satisfies all given conditions.
